caption: The drawing depicts a single metal shovel with a long, narrow handle and a flat, rounded blade. The handle is topped with a decorative, heart-shaped loop formed from two symmetrical spiral curls. The blade of the shovel is rusty, displaying various shades of brown, reddish-brown, and black, with lighter areas that indicate corrosion or wear. The metal handle transitions smoothly into the blade, and a rivet or binding is visible where the two parts are joined. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color with a few faint smudges and a handwritten note in the top left corner. There are no other objects or details present in the composition.
title: Fireplace Shovel
